title: algo_speedrun round input
description: Per-round proxy-eval sizing. This is the CHEAP pass that scores every round (spec defaults.*); the periodic full-scale deep eval over the top-K submissions runs out-of-band (tools/run_deep_eval.py, see HANDOFF.md §6) and is not configured here.

depth.description: Transformer depth for the proxy model. Small on purpose: this measures the training-loop change, not scale. model_dim = depth * aspect_ratio (fixed at 64).

total_batch_size.description: Total tokens per optimizer step. Must be a multiple of device_batch_size * max_seq_len.

num_iterations.description: Fixed step budget for the proxy pass -- deliberately tiny (nanochat's own documented CPU/Macbook smoke-test scale, see referee/train_runner.py).

eval_tokens.description: Tokens used to compute the final validation bpb (the scored metric).

seed.description: Overridden by the platform's per-round SEED; present for local dev only (tools/local_eval.py).
